envelope.description: ReviewJob core: whole call, MAP, merge, refusals, daemon driver

body.title: ReviewJob core: whole call, MAP, merge, refusals, daemon driver
body.summary: createReviewJob / nextCalls / applyAnswer with the whole-call path (one call with the supplied whole prompt when it fits or the budget is unknown), MAP over the cross product of each needed input source's batches (local findings and keyed notes, never absence findings), the finding merge (identical findings once) with parts counts, refusal re-planning (re-pack with the reported maxChars, else halves), and a daemon driver that runs a job's calls serially.
acceptanceChecks: A job whose whole prompt fits, or with an unknown budget, is exactly one call with the supplied whole prompt and schema.
Every MAP call fits when serialised and every original atom of every source is read whole by some MAP call, for inputs many times the budget.
A refused call is re-planned and no prompt is sent twice.
